ideas.title: Electoral Integrity in Question
ideas.description: Investigate the handling of ballots in Fulton County, Georgia, and explore the potential for electoral fraud.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the chain of custody for ballots.
questions: What is the current status of the investigation into the Fulton County ballot seizure?
Are there any other counties with similar issues?
ideas.insight: I believe that there may be a larger pattern of electoral fraud at play, and I recommend further investigation into the handling of ballots in other counties.
